journal_text: I feel scattered today even after the ocean session. Too many things on my mind.
The forest sounds helped me breathe and I feel a lot more settled and at peace.
I sat through the mountain session but everything still feels too heavy to move. I'm drowning in tasks.
I came in distracted but left with a clear head. Ready to tackle the day.
The rain was soothing but I still feel pulled in different directions. Not sure if I'm calm or restless.
I feel completely overloaded. The cafe sounds couldn't stop the noise in my head.
Nothing really shifted but I feel okay. Just steady.
The mountain session gave me exactly what I needed. Sharp and ready to work.
